analyst.summary: Gokul Agro Resources is a large integrated edible-oil, castor-oil and agri-processing company. Revenue growth was modest last quarter, but profit jumped sharply as the company's newly operational biodiesel plant and a push into higher-value specialty fats improved its product mix -- a credit-rating agency has also turned more positive on the company's outlook. This is a structurally thin-margin, commodity-linked business, so the improvement is encouraging but still early. We rate it a Hold.
